pipeline.asset: INTERCEPT Blood System for Red Blood Cells
pipeline.modality: Pathogen reduction medical device (small-molecule treatment of donor RBC units)
pipeline.target: Broad-spectrum inactivation of viruses, bacteria, parasites and donor leukocytes in red blood cell units

indications.indication: Transfusion of pathogen-reduced red blood cells in patients requiring chronic or acute RBC support
indications.trial_design: Randomized, controlled study comparing INTERCEPT-treated red blood cells to conventional untreated red blood cells in regions at potential risk for Zika and other transfusion-transmitted infections
key_milestones: October 2024: Dutch CBG closed initial MDR application for the RBC system without issuing CE Certificate of Conformity
July 2025: TUV-SUD completed clinical assessment of resubmitted MDR application; API review transferred from SUKL to ANSM (France)

indications.indication: Recovery and lifespan of INTERCEPT-treated RBCs in AS-1 (process-validation supportive study)
indications.trial_name: INTERCEPT RBC AS-1 Recovery and Lifespan Study
indications.trial_design: Open-label in vivo recovery and survival study of radiolabeled autologous INTERCEPT-treated RBCs prepared with AS-1

indications.indication: Challenge transfusion of INTERCEPT pathogen-reduced RBCs in subjects with or without pre-existing antibodies (immunogenicity / hemolytic transfusion reaction)
indications.trial_design: Phase 2 challenge transfusion study evaluating safety in subjects with or without pre-existing antibodies to INTERCEPT RBCs

approved_marketed.name: INTERCEPT Blood System for Platelets
approved_marketed.regulatory_status: FDA-approved (US); CE Mark (EU under MDR); marketed in US, parts of Europe, CIS, Middle East, Latin America

approved_marketed.name: INTERCEPT Blood System for Plasma
approved_marketed.regulatory_status: FDA-approved (US); CE Mark (EU under MDR); marketed in US, parts of Europe, CIS, Middle East, Latin America

approved_marketed.name: INTERCEPT Blood System for Cryoprecipitation (produces INTERCEPT Fibrinogen Complex / IFC and pathogen-reduced plasma, cryoprecipitate reduced)
approved_marketed.regulatory_status: FDA-approved in the US for treatment and control of bleeding (including massive hemorrhage) associated with fibrinogen deficiency
